title: Bentwaters nukes flown to Kirtland for analysis
place_text: RAF Bentwaters to Kirtland Air Force Base

tellings.quote: he was aware that shortly after this incident two tactical nuclear bombs were removed from a bunker at bentwaters flown aboard a c5a aircraft to Kirtland Air Force Base

plain: Shortly after the strange events of 1980 near RAF Bentwaters, an air base in England, two small nuclear bombs are said to have been taken from a bunker there and flown on a large C-5A cargo plane to Kirtland Air Force Base in New Mexico to be checked. Robert Hastings, a researcher who studies UFO reports at nuclear weapons sites, says he heard this from an unnamed retired colonel who handled weapons security for NATO, the Western military alliance. If true, it would mean the military feared the weapons had been affected by whatever happened.
